data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, the GitHub lookup, the top-repo check, the email fields and the discard, but it leaves out the blog step (opening {blog} in a new tab to read the latest post title) and has no blog parameter. It also lists extracted values (followers, stars, language, latest post) as input parameters, and it never says how to switch to the Mail tab, so an automation couldn't be built from it reliably.
